errors.text_span: докато в месец VIII (август) стълбът за 2022 е най-нисък, около 80,000
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar for month VIII, 2022 as the lowest in the chart. Visually, the bar for 2023 in the same month (VIII) appears slightly lower, and several other bars (e.g., 2023 for months IX and XII) are at a similarly low level around 82,000, making it impossible to definitively state that the VIII-2022 bar is the single lowest. The value is also closer to 82,000 than 80,000.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред на месеци
errors.evidence: The description claims the months on the x-axis are in alphabetical order. The x-axis shows Roman numerals from I to XII, which represents the months in chronological order, not alphabetical.
